# Sarang Vehale

> Portfolio of Sarang Vehale, a researcher working at the intersection of mathematics, quantum information theory and applied cybersecurity. Finishing a B.S. in Data Science at IIT Madras (expected May 2027) after completing an integrated B.Tech + M.Tech in Cyber Security at the National Forensic Sciences University (May 2026). Looking for research roles and PhD positions in quantum information theory, entropy, channels and coding.

This is a single static HTML page, with no build step and no backend. Every section (experience, research, projects, publications, training, questions, about, contact) is already in the raw HTML, fetchable directly without executing JavaScript. JavaScript only draws decorative geometry and runs the gallery and dialogs.

## Core

- [The whole site](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/): one page, every section below is a same-page anchor (#record, #research, #workshop, #publications, #training, #questions, #about, #contact).
- [Resume (PDF)](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/resume.pdf)

## Pages

- [Writing](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/writing/): essays and notes, one HTML page each.
- [Uses](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/uses/): desk, computers, everyday carry, watches.
- [Photos](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/photos/): photographs.
